fields.verdict: cross-sectional (mixed/other for the qualitative interviews defensible)
fields.why: All quantitative results come from the follow-up survey, read as cross-sectional; the 22 semistructured interviews (the article calls itself a 'qualitative study') have no design value. The brief would need a rule saying whether a qualitative interview component adds mixed/other.

brief_issues: No study_design value or rule for qualitative interview components (semistructured interviews) alongside a survey.
